kind: Immutable pre-value estimand and uncertainty clarification requested by independent reviewer and integrating lead

median_shift_sign.definition: Median EMC value minus median comparator value, on each specified deposited/native measurement scale. For the additional Hofvander log2(1+TPM) shift, median transformed EMC value minus median transformed comparator value.
median_shift_sign.interpretation: A negative shift means lower observed bulk RNA or assay feature signal in EMC. A_lower remains P(EMC < comparator) + 0.5 P(tie), so a larger A_lower and a negative median shift point in the same lower-EMC direction.
median_shift_sign.no_conversion: No pooled units, transformed-density count interpretation, old p/q inversion or new data calculation is authorized by this clarification.

specimen_resampling_ranges.definition: The pre-specified fixed-seed, 10000-draw, within-source and within-histotype specimen bootstrap produces conditional empirical 2.5th-to-97.5th percentile resampling ranges for A_lower and the EMC-minus-comparator median shift.
specimen_resampling_ranges.label: Conditional empirical specimen-resampling 95% range; not a population confidence interval or selection-adjusted significance.
specimen_resampling_ranges.dependence_and_selection: Source conditions are not proven independent donors. Unknown within-source or cross-study donor dependence, nonrandom specimen selection, and post-exposure target/comparator/direction selection are not resolved by specimen resampling. Nominal population coverage is not claimed. No cohorts are pooled.
specimen_resampling_ranges.boundary_degeneracy: At complete observed rank separation, all bootstrap draws may retain that separation and produce a degenerate boundary range for A_lower. Such a range describes the observed empirical support only; it does not establish zero population uncertainty, universal separation or a certain biological difference.
specimen_resampling_ranges.finite_and_missing: Finite-cell completeness remains unevaluated; original fixed-feature and missing-not-zero rules remain unchanged.

year_uncertainty.decision: Descriptive point estimates and exact stratum/pair counts only; no year-matched resampling range or confidence interval.
year_uncertainty.definition: For the already fixed, matching-available 2019 and 2021 strata, report each stratum A_lower and exact EMC/comparator counts, and the overall pair-weighted A_lower: sum(n_EMC_year * n_comparator_year * A_lower_year) divided by sum(n_EMC_year * n_comparator_year), over strata with both groups available.
year_uncertainty.limits: Preserve the existing 13/12/9 source subsets and the available-year denominators. Unmatched specimens remain visible. This is not adjustment of all 13 observations, a regression, an independent donor analysis or a pooled-year uncertainty claim.

scope_preserved: No target, probe, peak, comparator, threshold, cohort, source or outcome values added or changed. Original contract and control amendment remain intact; this amendment only makes sign and uncertainty interpretation explicit.
numerical_authorization: OFF. Final independent contract decision and explicit integrating-lead instruction remain required before new expression values, estimates or statistics.
